lines.en: Would you like to respond?
What would you like to say?
: I'm still impressed at how quickly you recovered from that.
: You know, it's a lot harder to cry when you're in a room full of girls staring at you and feeling bad for you.
: I honestly felt like my heart had dropped into like...my shoe.
: Which then made walking really hard but yeah.
: No bueno, Sensei. Zero total buenos.
: Well, I think that not turning it into more of a thing is a sign of maturity and I'm proud of you.
: Thanks, Dad. You're always looking out for me.
: Hold on, let me call my moms really quick and see if they'll let you into the family for real.
: Only downside is that I think Otoha hates them for some reason because they're lesbians and that's bad???
: I don't really think that's what Otoha was implying.
: Probably not. I kinda zoned out because of the heart-shoe.
: And also because I thought she was about to dump me. Which, if she did, I'd probably grow another heart just so THAT one could fall into my other shoe.
: Why do you keep talking about shoes?
: I just got new ones. Thank you for asking.
: Anyway, yeah. Parents suck and I'm cool.
: Just not cool enough to show to parents if you know what I mean.
: Fucking vaginas man. If only I could just grow a penis whenever I wanted.
: I am very glad that you can not.
: Me too. I probably wouldn't come to school anymore because I'd be busy messing around with it.
: They seem really wiggly and fun.
: Weird, for sure. But still wiggly and fun.
: Okay, I think that's a good stopping point for now.
: Are you gonna go wiggle your penis?
: Yup. You got me.
: Okay! Have fun, Sensei =X
: Wiggle that weiner good.
: Have things gotten any better since then?
: They...haven't gotten any worse?
: Which I guess is almost as good as getting better.
: Just not really.
: Like, Otoha still won't let me anywhere near her parents but at least she knows she's being a fucking asshole about it.
: It's just like...I don't get how you can knowingly be an asshole and not really STOP being an asshole about the thing you're being an asshole about.
: That's so many assholes, Sensei. SO MANY ASSHOLES.
: Well that took a turn.
: Yeah I'm sorry /rant
: Anyway, how's your day?
: You find out your significant other is embarrassed to date you?
: We're not done, are we?
: You bet your fuckin burrito we're not done
: Idc if I have to frickin' go over to her house and hold a boombox over my head like in that one 80's movie.
: Do you know where I can get a boombox btw? Do they even sell those anymore?
: Have we moved on or do you want to complain about your girlfriend a little more before we talk about boomboxes?
: She's lucky she's so fucking hot because IF SHE WASN'T I woulda been like okay peace bye and then like dropkicked her or something
: But I kinda want to kiss her a lot more because she tasted really good and it was hot
: Man, girls are the worst. Especially the girls that think girls shouldn't date girls. Like....they're GIRLS. Have you ever SEEN girls?
: They're so cute!
: I want to say I'm having a hard time following you right now, but I think I get it.
: Girls really are just cute.
: Sensei, has anyone ever told you you'd make a good lesbian?
: Nope.
: Is it because of your weiner?
: Probably, Rin.
: Well, I think you would be good, Sensei.
: Keep it up.
: Thank you?...
: ANYWAY, g2g. Otoha and I have couples counseling. And by couples counseling I mean we're going to talk about music on the phone and pretend there's not a rift in our relationship.
: But thanks for asking. I appreciate it.
: Being a lesbian sounds really hard.
: I mean, we're technically bi. We're just in a lesbian relationship.
: It really sucks what happened at the Christmas party, but I can kind of understand the sentiment.
: You better have a really good follow up to that one buddy
: I just also understand what it's like to not really be able to tell others about a relationship.
: Which girl is it and how long has it been Ayane
: I'm speaking in general terms. I'm not in a relationship like that with anyone.
: What?
: I don't speak emoji.
: Okay here let me translate. The first one says lolsure and the second one also says lolsure, but in a more sarcastic and funny kind of way.
: Yaaaay what a great time to remind me you hooked up with my first love.
: That's...not exactly what I was going for.
: Well that's where you went and now I have to picture it for the rest of the night.
: You know I'm sorry, right.
: It's whatever. I'll just try and wash it out with thoughts of Otoha and hope you don't show up to fingerbang her in my fantasy either.
: What I was really trying to say is that it's a really...human issue. And that it might be good try and see things from Otoha's perspective.
: Are you being serious
: Well, she's not planning on doing this forever, is she?
: She probably just needs some time to prepare them.
: Prepare them for what?? I'm a girl, not fucking Cthulu.
: Don't get me wrong, being Cthulu would be pretty fucking sweet, but there's nothing she should have to prepare them for.
: Telling them she's dating a girl should be no harder than telling them she's dating a boy and I hate that I have to deal with this.
: Well I hope you don't have to deal with it much longer.
: Me too. It's hard.
: I need a hug.
: Come hug me.
: I can't right now.
: Later then?
: We'll see.
: Fine...
: But it better be a good one. Not one of those half assed Sensei hugs you always give.
: That's...just how I do it, though.
: Not anymore it's not.
: See you later Sensei =)
